viewing_check: Open the tray and read maker names stamped or painted on the lures: Ashley, Cobra, Tillins, Dickson, any hand-made labelled wooden minnows. Photograph the best few wooden lures (undersides, hook hangers). Check whether the Tillins cards are genuine and whether any older wooden pieces are in good paint.
